name: otp-slate-ui
description: OTP Slate React portals and Node API, with standalone UI references

scripts.test: node tests/ui-smoke.cjs && node tests/admin-smoke.cjs && node tests/organization-smoke.cjs
scripts.build:app: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @slate/api && npm run build -w @slate/student && npm run build -w @slate/platform-admin && npm run build -w @slate/organization-admin
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,student,platform,organization "npm run dev -w @slate/api" "npm run dev -w @slate/student" "npm run dev -w @slate/platform-admin" "npm run dev -w @slate/organization-admin"
scripts.test:app: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @slate/api && npm run test -w @slate/api
